svg.title: C12 / HUBBLE COSMIC GLOW engineering mission profile
svg.desc: C12, HUBBLE COSMIC GLOW. Original project: SKYSURF: Measuring the Brightness of the Sky. Session C: Astronomy & Space Physics. Scientific question: Does a common diffuse residual remain after accounting for solar geometry, Galactic dust, detector thermal background, object wings, and calibration covariance? Testable hypothesis: A hierarchical joint fit across visits and filters will reveal which residual spectral components are reproducible and which follow foreground geometry or instrumental nuisance variables.. screened Hubble data and quantify uncertainty in separating zodiacal,
Galactic, instrumental, and extragalactic components. Complement the
simulation project with an observational inference program. A residual above
one foreground model is treated as a model-dependent limit or candidate
